{{Quote|I rejected the Jedi Order's ''exclusivity'' and established ''my own'' school for those attuned to the Force. I'm teaching them how to wield the Force as I do.|Shon-Ju to Aayla Secura|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>}}
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] '''school''' had been established by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shon-Ju]]. After his expulsion from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he was inspired to create his own school for [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. He [[Unidentified Ithorian (Force student)|took]] [[Unidentified Zabrak (Force user)|three]] [[Unidentified male (Force user)|students]] and taught them to use the Force the way he did, directing it through their [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. During the Clone Wars, his school [[Shon-Ju's castle|relocated]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]] in order to pursue the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]]. There they rescued the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. Shon-Ju agreed to join with her, but later betrayed Secura. His actions led to him suffering injuries at her hands.

==History==
A [[The Force/Legends|Force]] school had been founded by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shon-Ju]] by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Shon-Ju had been exiled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When he was leaving the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], he met [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], a man who had [[Lost Twenty/Legends|left the Order]]; Dooku advised Shon-Ju to follow his own path. Shon-Ju then spent time in exile; he continued to hone his connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and found a tranquil balance and the ability to direct the Force through his [[hand]]s. He rejected the exclusivity of the Jedi Order and established this school to teach his [[Unidentified Ithorian (Force student)|three]] [[Unidentified Zabrak (Force user)|students]] [[Unidentified male (Force user)|how]] to use the Force as he did. They all wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi-style robes]].

During the Clone Wars, Shon-Ju relocated his school to a [[Shon-Ju's castle|retreat]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]] in order to put a stop to the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]]'s operation. There they meet the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who was pursued by [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]], Duum's chief of security. Shon-Ju's students intervened and forced Sabat to flee. Secura passed out from her injuries and was taken to the castle.

When Secura woke up, she sought out Shon-Ju, and the two discussed Shon-Ju's life and teachings while the students trained down below them. He told Secura he was learning as much from his students as they were for him. The two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] then agreed to join forces to stop Duum.

Shon-Ju and Secura infiltrated [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]] and were captured. While Duum was [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|otherwise occupied]], Shon-Ju broke free of his shackles. He betrayed Secura by renegging on their agreement to bring Duum in alive; Secura broke free of her shackles in time to save what was left of Duum. She and Shon-Ju started fighting each other, and Duum took the chance to escape. The struggle ended when Secura cut off Shon-Ju's hands with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]; the man ran into the flames of the dying station, telling Secura the Jedi kept taking from him.

Unbeknownst to Secura, Shon-Ju survived and returned to his students. The Ithorian assisted him while he was being fitted with new prosthesis. When the Ithorian commented that he was whole again, Shon-Ju used his new hands to shear through the [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], saying he was more than whole.

==Behind the scenes==
The members of this school and their tenents appear in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]].''
